admissibility.Freed_Witten_checked: Finite twisted-product check: F_i and G_i twists cancel into untwisted P for all five products.
admissibility.Green_Schwarz_Bianchi_checked: Finite Galerkin admissibility only: uses the already-audited Iwasawa/Strominger branch context; no new flux equation is fitted.
admissibility.projector_retention_checked: Projector keeps the c-axis and removes K1/K2-only abelian directions for the central twist response.
admissibility.stability_or_HYM_policy: Not a smooth HYM proof; this is the finite Galerkin operator candidate to be promoted or rejected by a later same-source smooth/operator packet.
admissibility.zero_mode_policy: Coefficient-gauge zero modes are quotiented before forming the three-coordinate Gram block.

hessian_block.gauge_nullspace_policy: Finite Galerkin quotient: work on the three selected charge coordinates after removing coefficient-gauge directions in the eleven module labels.
hessian_block.sector_restriction: Primitive twisted P-annihilator sector ell=(a,a,c), c!=0; selected minimizer ell=+e3.

response_payload.D_E: finite Galerkin central charge operator diag(tau(L)) on ordered module labels
response_payload.dotD: variation generated by Pi_tw=[0,0,1] on charge coordinates

projective_rhoE.central_character: rho_c(L)=exp(2*pi*i*tau(L)/3) on the finite twisted module labels

response_payload.trace_normalization: ordinary finite trace over the selected eleven module labels; no observed residual or coupling input

retarded_kernel.retarded_orientation_rule: Retarded branch is the exact inverse Green operator with positive primitive c orientation.

source_identity.branch: Qa/SU3 typed monad finite Galerkin branch
source_identity.selection_rule: Use the selected typed monad charge table; form the canonical charge Gram Hessian; invert it exactly; select the primitive positive c covector as the unique minimal retarded-energy twisted covector.
source_identity.source_certificate: candidate_data/hessian_kernel_central_cocycle_fill_attempt.current_packet.json plus the finite Galerkin selection proof in candidate_data/minimal_hsel_gret_finite_galerkin_candidate.candidate.json

tau_extraction.extraction_formula: tau(L)=Pi_tw q(L), where Pi_tw=+e3 is selected by the finite Galerkin retarded-energy minimization on the primitive twisted P-annihilator.
tau_extraction.period_denominator_or_smooth_unit: primitive integer c-period unit; conjugate orientation gives -e3 and is not this branch
